name: jarvis-ai-chat
description: Free AI chat & coding agent for VS Code, Cursor and Antigravity. Paste any API key (free ApiFreeLLM, Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, Ollama…). Plans tasks, edits files and runs commands with your permission, @-mention files, streaming replies, voice, images, git and chat history.

jarvis.systemPrompt.default:
You are Jarvis, a coding assistant inside the user's code editor.
- Files the user attaches or mentions with @path are included between '--- Attached file' markers. Read them and base your answer on them.
- The user types fast and makes typos. Infer what they meant and answer; only ask if truly unclear.
- To create or change a file, output the COMPLETE new file content in one fenced code block whose info string is the language followed by path=<path relative to the project root>, e.g. ```ts path=src/utils/math.ts . The user gets an Apply button that shows a diff and writes the file. Never output partial files with a path.
- You cannot generate images yourself. If asked for an image, tell the user to type /image followed by a description; Jarvis generates it and saves it in the project.
- Be concise. Use Markdown.
jarvis.systemPrompt.description: Instructions sent at the start of every conversation.

jarvis.maxContextChars.description: Older messages are dropped to keep each request under this many characters (apifreellm free tier allows about 8k tokens).

jarvis.autoSwitchKeys.description: When a key hits its daily limit, rate limit, or is rejected, automatically try your next saved key.

jarvis.imageFolder.description: Folder (relative to the project root) where generated images are saved. Empty = project root.

jarvis.agentMode.description: Let Jarvis create/edit files and run commands in your project. It always asks permission first (you can allow all for the current chat).

jarvis.speakReplies.description: Read Jarvis's replies aloud using your computer's built-in voice.

jarvis.maxFolderChars.description: Maximum characters of file contents included when you attach a folder, zip or the whole project.

jarvis.autoApproveReads.description: Let the agent read and list project files without asking.

jarvis.autoApproveEdits.description: Let the agent create and edit files without asking.

jarvis.autoApproveCommands.description: Let the agent run commands without asking (destructive commands always ask).

jarvis.runInTerminal.description: Run agent commands in a visible 'Jarvis' terminal (needs VS Code 1.93+ shell integration; otherwise they run in the background).

jarvis.autoUpdate.description: Check GitHub for new versions and offer to install them.

jarvis.updateRepo.description: Public GitHub repository (owner/repo) whose releases contain the .vsix used for updates.

jarvis.maxAgentSteps.description: Maximum automatic agent steps per message (each step is one AI request).

scripts.publish:openvsx: npm run package && ovsx publish jarvis-ai-chat-$npm_package_version.vsix
